name: childKey
header:
/** * Retrieve the part of the given key which is a child part of the given parent key. * A key is a child of another key if it has the same parts at the beginning as the other key. * This function will only return the child parts, so without the beginning parent parts. * *

If the resulting key is the same as the given key, the key is considered not to be a child * of the given parent key, so an empty key will be returned.

* * @param key the original key. * @param parentKey a possible parent key of the original key. * @return the part of the given key which is a child of the given parent key. */ public static String childKey(String key, String parentKey) {
